A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AGF research, with readable text, equations, figures and complete appendices. v1 Appendices A–E correspond to v2 Appendices B–F; v2 adds a related-work Appendix A. No material gaps prevent comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original numerical experiments on diagonal and fully connected linear networks, linear transformers and modular addition in Figures 3–6, plus the trajectory analysis in appendix Figure 7.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and appendix Figure 7, comparing simulated training dynamics with AGF predictions.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 retains the same utility-maximization, neuron-activation and cost-minimization steps. The model architectures, objectives and adaptations in Sections 3–5 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same regression, in-context learning and modular-addition settings, including commuting and non-commuting covariance cases. Appendix A discusses other research settings without adding experiments.

E2.justification: The AGF versus gradient-flow/gradient-descent comparisons and theoretical reference curves in Figures 3–7 are unchanged. Newly cited methods are discussed as related work, not added as evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The stated initialization, time rescaling, data construction and evaluation procedures are unchanged. For example, Figure 6 retains p = 20, H = 18, the same three Fourier coefficients and training over all p² input pairs.

E4.justification: The initialization-scale comparisons, covariance-case comparisons and Figure 7 analysis of loss, parameters and return to dormancy are retained. No ablation, robustness test or supplementary empirical analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests for these experiments. v2 introduces no change in statistical or uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Figures 3–7 retain the same plotted results, including loss trajectories, singular-value dynamics and Fourier-feature emergence. Their captions and associated findings are unchanged; no result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: New Appendix A.1 explicitly defines the NTK through parameter-gradient inner products and describes feature learning through kernel evolution. This is a limited definitional addition; the AGF assumptions, theorems, conjectures and proofs remain unchanged after appendix renumbering.

C1.justification: The abstract, four introduction contributions and concluding claims retain the same scope: the AGF framework, diagonal-network convergence, unification of linear-network analyses and prediction of Fourier-feature emergence.

C2.justification: Appendix A.1 newly clarifies that the paper adopts the deep-learning-theory notion of features while studying settings associated with mechanistic interpretability, and notes this definition's limited interpretability. Existing result interpretations and Section 6 limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The existing initialization prescriptions, synthetic-data specifications and analytical implementation details are retained. No new hyperparameters, hardware, runtime or code/data-access information is supplied.

R1.justification: New Appendix A substantially expands positioning through discussions of mean-field, teacher-student, multi-index, single-step and ReLU learning theories. Section 5 additionally acknowledges Tian's algebraic-structure and simplicity-bias account. The bibliography adds 28 works while retaining the original references.

P1.justification: v2 adds a structured related-work appendix, a corresponding introduction pointer, a short Section 5 expansion and acknowledgment edits. The main narrative and original technical appendices otherwise remain intact, with updated cross-references.

P2.justification: The additions cause limited text and figure-position reflow, changed bibliography wrapping and later placement of the original appendices. All seven figures retain their panels, axes and plotted content; no figure or table is added or redesigned.

improvement.justification: v2 improves clarity and scholarly positioning by explaining its meaning of features and relating AGF to several established theoretical approaches in Appendix A. Section 5 also improves attribution. These are useful contextual gains; the experiments, proofs and unresolved general-convergence and depth limitations remain unchanged.
